consequence.statement: Environments that enable the CAInjectorMerging feature gate will see the ca-injector merge new CA certificates into the injected target instead of outright replacing the existing certificate.
consequence.remediation: If you enable CAInjectorMerging, verify that merged CA contents are acceptable wherever the ca-injector injects certificates.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds the CAInjectorMerging feature gate to the ca-injector, which when enabled changes the ca-injector's behavior to merge in new CA certificates instead of outright replacing the existing one.
